# Rough Linen — original texture sources

- Publisher: Poly Haven; https://polyhaven.com/a/rough_linen
- Photography: colormass. Processing: Rico Cilliers.
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal; https://polyhaven.com/license and https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Poly Haven permits commercial use and redistribution inside sold products without mandatory attribution.
- Original 2K diffuse, OpenGL normal and roughness JPGs are retained unchanged. `receipt.json` records the exact download URLs and provider MD5 hashes; `info.json` and `files.json` retain publisher metadata.
- The original blue diffuse scan is recolored to ivory for `assets/items/medical/packed_bandage/`. The model and paper label are project-authored.
- This folder is ignored by Godot's importer. Runtime materials use the derived PNGs in the packed-bandage family.
